facts.locator: The station diagram currently linked by Sanko identifies the JR Kumamoto Shirakawa entrance and continuous public forecourt paths serving bus platforms 7 and 3. The selected current GTFS airport trip starts at 100339_7 and its reverse terminates at 100339_3; platform 3 is preserved exactly, not replaced with the separate through-service alighting platform 8. This fact establishes the public passage, not a claim that all airport arrivals use platform 3. Bind each exact stop independently to the JR conventional component already linked to Shinkansen. No walking time or accessibility is inferred.
